text:
Ava: Quick sync — we need to pick the minimum telemetry surface for the console launch this quarter. Customers are asking for cost breakdown + error triage hooks.
Ravi: Can we decouple cost breakdown from full tracing? sampling + lightweight metrics could unblock.
Marta: +1. If we ship cost per-route + token buckets we cover 80% of asks. Full trace hooks are higher effort.
Jon: From a UX perspective, customers want a ‘why is this expensive’ card that points to top renders/long tails not raw spans.
Ava: Proposal: launch "Cost Insights (v1)" + "Error Quicklinks" and label traces as opt-in for Enterprise. Agree?
Ravi: Sounds reasonable. Need SLO on telemetry cost. I suggest a telemetry budget default of 1% infra spend per team, configurable.
Marta: Implementation note: we can expose sampling config and a simple KV tag to mark traced requests. Example:
```
telemetry:
  sampling_rate: 0.02
  trace_label: console_v1
```
Ava: Nice. For launch criteria, we should require: 1) cost card + per-route breakdown, 2) error aggregation by route + stack peek, 3) telemetry budget guardrails live in console.
Ravi: Also need fallback if tracing bbox fails — show degraded error counts and attach last-known sample.
Jon: UX acceptance: add a compact panel view and a detailed panel. Default to compact for non-admins.
Marta: Timeline: we can ship cost + error panels in 2 sprints; tracing opt-in in 4. Risk: high-cardinality metrics will spike cost if left unbounded.
Ava: Decision: ship cost+error panels to beta customers (SMB + a couple mid-market) with tracing opt-in for Enterprise. We'll include an analytics gating metric: telemetry_cost_change <= +15% week-over-week.
Ravi: I'll add a deploy-bot check to fail rollout if telemetry budget exceeded. @deploy-bot please add a rollback hook.
deploy-bot: noted — will post deploy status and rollback trigger if telemetry_budget > threshold.
Ava: Next steps: Marta to write PRD for v1 surface (includes sample configs), Ravi to add budget guardrails, Jon to mock the compact/detail panes. I'll coordinate beta customers.
Marta: I'll drop the PRD link here when ready. ETA EOD Wednesday.
Ravi: I'll prototype budget check and a smoke test for sampling this week.
Ava: Thanks — keeping scope narrow should make this launchable. :thumbsup:
